evalBarVisibility.Name: Evaluation bar visibility
evalBarVisibility.Hint: Who sees the evaluation bar. Showing it to players reveals how the fight is going.

playerBestTurn.Name: Players may analyze their own turns
playerBestTurn.Hint: Players can run Best Turn for tokens they own. Their analysis only uses creatures they can see.

gmAuthoritative.Name: GM-authoritative evaluation
gmAuthoritative.Hint: When the bar is shown to players, they receive the GM's score instead of analyzing locally, so hidden creatures never influence what they see.

forecastRuns.Name: Forecast simulations
forecastRuns.Hint: Simulated fights per threat forecast. More runs are more precise and slower.

countMovesAsStride.Name: Count token moves as Stride
countMovesAsStride.Hint: Each move of the current combatant's token spends one action in the turn tracker.

autoCover.Name: Automatic cover
autoCover.Hint: Compute cover from walls and creatures.

cropMargin.Name: Analysis margin (squares)
cropMargin.Hint: Map kept around the combatants when building the analysis board.

searchMs.Name: Best Turn time limit (ms)
searchMs.Hint: The search returns its best fully analyzed answer when the time runs out.

monsterSearchMs.Name: GM assistant time per creature (ms)
monsterSearchMs.Hint: Time limit for each monster's plan.

forecastWorkers.Name: Forecast workers
forecastWorkers.Hint: Background threads used by the threat forecast (0 shares the main analysis worker).

evalBarSide.Name: Evaluation bar side
evalBarSide.Hint: Which side of the screen shows the bar.

BestTurn.hypotheticalHint: Not this creature's turn: analyzed as if its turn started now.
BestTurn.endTurn: No action improves the position. End the turn.

Forecast.disclaimer: Simulations use a simple tactical policy for every creature and seeded dice. They estimate the odds; they do not predict your table.

Notify.noTokenOnScene: This actor has no token on the current scene.
